summary: Request for usage-linked audit slice and hashproof for billing discrepancy - per-event redaction required
description: Issue summary: Customer disputes a February invoice line for high token usage tied to the Redwood API. They request an auditable export of the raw request/response events for 2026-02-01..2026-02-28 with per-event HMACs, a deterministic redaction map (PII removed with reversible tokenization for legal review), and a reconciliation manifest that ties each billed line item to event hashes. Impact: potential billing credit and legal preservation requirement for an ongoing audit. Environment: prod us-east.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Recreate the export query used by customer: events where customer_org_id = 'nb-capital' AND timestamp between 2026-02-01 and 2026-02-28
2) Run /v1/audit/export with format=ndjson and include_request=true include_response=true
3) Compute event-level HMAC using current KMS key id (redwood-kek-2025) over canonicalized JSON fields (event_id,timestamp,org_id,request_id,token_count)
4) Crosswalk each exported event_id to billing ledger entries in payments-db.billed_tokens where invoice_period = 2026-02
5) Validate that no event_id appears more than once in the final export bundle and that resume tokens are present for streaming resumes

investigation_notes: Initial triage (Support): customer provided invoice line 42 and export query; requested signed export and reconciliation manifest.
SRE observation: duplicate part file found in s3 prefix for nb-capital (events/2026/02/part-12 and part-12.copy). Hashes differ - probable reingest from a replay job on 2026-02-07.

Billing note: invoice matched tokens aggregated from billed_events table which deduplicates by event_id, but reconciliation script used event timestamp window only and did not deduplicate duplicates introduced by reingest bicycle job.

Hypothesis: a transient replay job (PR #7940) re-published an archive partition without idempotency markers; downstream export tooling counted both original and replayed events in the ad-hoc reconciliation run used to generate invoice reports.
SRE action: quarantined copy objects with suffix '.copy' and generated a clean export using canonicalized dedupe logic. Created temp-s3 export at s3://redwood-support/slices/nb-capital/2026-02-clean/
Security: agreed on reversible tokenization approach for PII fields (email, user_id) using per-customer salt and provided proof of KMS DEK rotation id in export manifest.
Risk: legal hold request received from customer on 2026-02-26; export must include chain-of-custody and tamper-evidence (HMAC over event bundle and manifest).

resolution_summary: Provided a deduplicated, HMAC-signed NDJSON export to the customer at s3://redwood-support/slices/nb-capital/2026-02-final/ with per-event HMACs (kek_id=redwood-kek-2025 v2). Delivered a reconciliation manifest linking 100% of billed ledger lines to event hashes. Applied a $7,430 credit to invoice 2026-02 under support credit ref SC-2026-031. Internal fixes: merged PR 7940 rollback to enforce idempotent reingest and added a reconciliation sanity check to billing job (PR 8073). Created internal task INT-4499 to add automated monthly self-check for replay-induced duplicates.
